newsitem.title: USA: Fed issues order against Midland ex-trader.
newsitem.headline: Fed issues order against Midland ex-trader.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Monday that it has issued an order of prohibition against Damian Cope, a former trader at the New York branch of Midland Bank plc of London.

"Mr. Cope, without admitting to any allegation, consented to the issuance of the order due to his alleged falsification of books and records relating to his interest-rate derivatives trading activities," the Fed said.
Midland Bank is a unit of HSBC Holdings plc of Hong Kong.
The Fed said that Cope pleaded guilty last Aug 20 to forgery in connection with falsification of books and records but provided no other details.
